field.name: description
field.placeholder: Shown on the lodge calendar and in the newsletter — keep it short and public-facing.

xpath.div: Assign who is scheduled to work and their role. When an assigned person clocks in during the event window, their timeclock punch is auto-tagged to this event below.

button.name: action_distribute_gratuity
button.help: Split the bar and kitchen gratuity pools across the matching shifts, by hours, for payroll.

button.name: action_pay_coordinator
button.help: Post the coordinator fee to the tagged coordinator's timecard as a flat payout (no clocked hours needed).

button.name: action_submit
button.confirm: Submit this event for Board review?

button.name: action_receive_deposit
button.invisible: not x_is_event or x_is_elks_event or x_deposit_received

button.name: action_add_coordinator_fee
button.invisible: not x_is_event or x_is_elks_event or not x_sale_order_id

button.name: action_create_deposit_invoice
button.invisible: not x_is_event or x_is_elks_event or x_quote_total <= 0

button.name: action_create_final_invoice
button.invisible: not x_is_event or x_is_elks_event or x_quote_total <= 0

field.name: x_event_date
field.help: Set from the Event Date field at the top of the form.

separator.string: Department Call-Outs (print or email a quote request)

div.span: Or use Print > Department Call-Out for a printable copy.

field.name: x_bar_drink_requests
field.placeholder: Signature cocktails, wine, kegs, specific requests...

page.name: event_rooms
page.p: Add a room with "Add a line" (its rate, cleaning, and service fees fill in automatically); remove one with the trash icon. Adjust any fee per event.

page.name: event_costs
page.p: Customer charges that roll into the single "Event Rental" price (bar, food, A/V, linens, security, etc.). Untick "Taxable" for items that aren't taxed. These are billed to the customer — the lodge's own costs are tracked via the Labor section and linked Purchase Orders.

page.name: board_approval
page.div: Draft — review the event details, then click "Submit for Approval" when ready.

field.name: x_board_notes
field.placeholder: Notes or conditions from the vote...

group.string: Labor (internal estimate for P&L — not charged to the customer)

button.name: action_build_labor_costs
button.help: Rebuild the Bar / Event / Cleaning / Catering service lines on the Event Costs tab from the planned hours x the Lodge Settings rates (charge = cost + markup + service fee; COGS = cost).

button.name: action_trueup_labor_hours
button.help: Sets estimated hours to the actual timeclock hours per role and rolls the actual labor cost into the P&L.

field.name: x_contract_notes
field.placeholder: Terms, conditions, and agreement details for the invoice...
